استذنبا (form X)
# اِسْتَذْنَبَا (istaḏnabā) /is.tað.na.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# اُسْتُذْنِبَا (ustuḏnibā) /us.tuð.ni.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# اِسْتَذْنِبَا (istaḏnibā) /is.tað.ni.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
